scientific_integrity: An unconditional symbolic proof is provided; exact finite enumeration is corroboration only. Previously published examples are acknowledged; no independent audit or external certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to \(p>M=2^{k+1}-1\) and \(p>(p-M)^2\); the conjectured abundance bound is not proved outside this strip. Primality and infinitude of eligible \(q\) are not asserted. A differently indexed earlier equivalent theorem remains a possible originality risk.
title: An exact near-Mersenne classification of three-prime weird numbers
